jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Machine Learning Approaches to Conservation Condition Needs of Historic Buildings
jobs.description:
This is NTNU
NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   
Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position
For a position as a PhD Candidate, the goal is a completed doctoral education up to an obtained doctoral degree.

We are looking for a PhD candidate for one of 13 PhD positions in Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) CHARM (Conservation of Heritage Architecture, buildings and sites by Resilient Methods: hydro-climate factors) project. The main objective of CHARM MSCA Doctoral Network project is to develop new sustainable conservation and restoration solutions, adapted to the current and future climate conditions, designed in a circular economy philosophy, having a low environmental footprint and high handprint. CHARM also responds to socio-economical requirements of wellbeing and proposes conservation/restoration solutions economically acceptable and respecting the cultural value of buildings.

CHARM proposes a holistic approach including:

• Site observation and data collection
• Data preparation to be used by AI, models, etc
• Methods for understanding and modelling past and future degradation of architectural heritage
• Sustainable conservation solutions to several observed problems
• Assessment of the impact of architectural conservation on the environment and of the environment (past, present and future) on architectural heritage
• Bidirectional interactions with society proposing risk management plans but also taking into account the society wills and needs
The vision of CHARM MSCA project is to educate young and talented scientists towards a combined high-level experimental and data driven approach for the early-stage accurate, precise detection of hydro-climate impact on cultural heritage, to answer to recruitment needs in time of climate change and natural hazards impact about research and innovation in the sector of cultural heritage conservation and restoration. 

CHARM network gathers excellent academic centers that have decennial experience in the field of risk assessment, adaptation and mitigation solutions to the climate change impact, conservation of cultural heritage and restoration, documented by scientific papers published in high impact-factor journals, and by previous EU funded research projects. CHARM puts together researchers from universities and research organisms, national and local organizations in charge of Cultural Heritage conservation, Small and Midsize Enterprises, industrial producer of building materials, and Non-Governmental Organization, from 9 European and 1 South American countries.
Description of DC2 PhD position
Project title: Understanding conservation condition and rehabilitation needs at district scale in time of energy saving and climate change via machine learning driven method

Topic in brief:

The aim is to implement an approach based on artificial intelligence (AI) in the form of CNN to automatically detect cracks and morphological indices in order to manage the large amount of data obtained from photogrammetry and earth observations images.

Objectives:

This doctoral project aims to develop deep learning neural networks to investigate data in available database (e.g., EU building stock observatory and other similar database) to:

• classify building stock at district scale more prone to decay based on buildings construction year, location, main constitutive material, exposure, use and
• to predict potential maintenance and restoration priority based on (i) and existing energy retrofit directive and/or risk maps 
Expected results:

(i)to build high-quality dataset highlighting the façade that is more prone to decay at district/city level from existing raw database; 

(ii) to apply deep learning neural networks (e.g., convolutional neural network) to perform semi-automatic decay pattern segmentation and associated mapping; 

(iii) to correlate the maintenance of buildings at district/city level with decay patterns/features at district scale to prioritize large scale intervention; and 

(iv) to optimize the maintenance activities by leveraging these correlations learned by machine-learning based approaches. 

Supervisory Committee:

• Main supervisor: Full prof. Chiara Bertolin, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
• Co-supervisor: Associate prof. Chao Gao, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
• Mentor: Dr. Marie Louise Anker, Department Director at Nidaros Cathedral Restoration Works. (Non.Academic)
 

Planned secondments

SECONDMENT 1 - Prof. P. Fafalios (FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas, Crete) M12, duration: 4 weeks, AI and ML algorithms,

SECONDMENT 2 - Prof. Carradò (CY Cergy Paris University) Karima El Ganaoui, ESTI Pau CY Tech, M24, duration: 4 weeks, AI materials
Duties of the position
• Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
• Develop a quantitative deep-learning-based framework to detect the micro-cracks and validate the developed framework
• Define micro-scale indices to evaluate crack morphological characteristics and validate developed the indices
• Classify the micro-morphologies and damages of undamage and damage materials and/or hazard prone or not buildings and landscape
• Participate in other relevant research and dissemination activities through our international collaborators
• Conduct and publish high-level research at peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
• Carry on condition monitoring campaigns and surveys in situ
• Write and defend a PhD thesis
Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.
Required selection criteria
• You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
• You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
• You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme
• Excellent written and oral English
• Strong background in applying deep learning neural networks on image segmentation associated with materials and the built environment
• Excellent programming skills in Python and Matlab
PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Preferred selection criteria
• Experience in processing-imaging techniques (e.g. 3D Data Processing, point clouds, geospatial Analysis)
• Knowledge and technical skills of condition monitoring, analytical damage functions and/or analytical methods/modelsPersonal characteristics
To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

• Strong interest and self-motivated attitude to explore scientific questions
• Think and work independently
• Team player with cooperative attitude
• Good communication skills
Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.
We offer
• Opportunity to carry our cutting-edge research in the area of applying machine learning technique to detection, classification and prediction of material degradation and get multidisciplinary and multisectoral training by experts and experienced supervisors from academic world
• Opportunity to publish your research findings in working team and participate the national and international conferences
• Opportunity to stay at our academic partners at FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas in Crete (Greece), and Cergy Paris University in Paris, France.
• Opportunity to work in an international team and be part of a network of 13 PhD students
• An exciting job with an important mission in society
• Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
• Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
• Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
• Working capital that can be used to implement the project
• Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
• Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
• Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.
Diversity
Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.
Salary and conditions
In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding from Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) for CHARM project.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.
About the application
The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

• Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
• CV 
• Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
• Motivation letter justifying your interest and fit for the position
• Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
• Possibly certificates
• Names and contact information of three relevant referees
If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. jobs.occupation: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Idura is looking for a Norway-based Sales Development Representative to join our team. Demand for our eID (electronic identity) solutions is growing fast, and there’s a big opportunity to help organizations integrate secure logins and digital signatures using eIDs. We want an ambitious salesperson to help us capture it.

About Idura
We help organizations securely verify users and support digital signing through eID integrations. As an official MitID broker in Denmark, we also support additional European eIDs like BankID, FTN and more. Our solutions are KYC-compliant, user-friendly and aligned with standards such as PAdES and eIDAS.

In September 2024, Idura was acquired by Stø (formerly BankID BankAxept), strengthening Stø’s position in European digital identity. Stø is owned by the Norwegian banks through Vipps Holding AS. That means you get the backing of a major player, with the pace and ownership of a growing company in its early stages.

The role
As our SDR in Norway, you’ll be at the front of our growth in the Norwegian market. You’ll handle inbound leads, hunt for new ones and support the sales cycle from first contact to signed deal. You’ll be a key part of the sales team, making sure every customer gets a great experience with Idura.

You’ll also help build Idura’s presence in Norway and support the sales team with administrative tasks when needed. You’ll report to our VP of Sales, Lars Mørch, and work day to day with our Norwegian Country Manager, Håkon Tveita.

What you’ll do
• 
Discover new industries, find leads, book meetings and grow the pipeline

• 
Drive Idura’s growth and expansion in the Norwegian market

• 
Support the sales team with administrative tasks

What we’re looking for
• 
2+ years of experience in B2B Sales or Busiess Development

• 
An ambitious, self-motivated person who wants to grow with the company

• 
Strong business understanding

• 
Fluent in Norwegian and English

• 
Experience with APIs and other technical integrations is a plus

• 
Experience from a similar role is a plus

Ready to apply?
We’re reviewing applications on an ongoing basis and are ready to move fast with the right candidates. If this sounds like you, don’t wait. Send in your application today. We’d love to hear from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:
Idura is a Copenhagen-based company specializing in secure user authentication and digital signature solutions using electronic identities (eIDs).

We empower companies to integrate eIDs into websites or applications effortlessly, ensuring an efficient, secure login or signature process at a cost-effective price. As an official MitID broker in Denmark, we offer MitID as well as a range of European eIDs, including BankID in Sweden and Norway, Finnish Trust Network (FTN) and itsme in Belgium. Our mission is to ensure the highest level of security in digital verification, making the digital world a safer place to roam.

Authentication
We provide a fast and simple integration of eIDs for businesses that want to verify their customers on their website or app. Our solution allows your users to authenticate themselves with secure and KYC compliant eIDs, which provides the most secure and user-friendly login experience possible.

Digital signatures
Implement digital signatures into your workflow and sign PDF documents digitally with eIDs. We ensure that all of our digital signatures are secure and compliant with PAdES and eIDAS.

jobs.occupation: Postdoktor i idrettsvitenskap
jobs.description:
Om stillingen
Ved Universitetet i Agder, Fakultet for helse- og idrettsvitenskap er det ledig en 100% stilling som postdoktor i idrettsvitenskap, tilknyttet Institutt for idrettsvitenskap og kroppsøving, for en periode på tre, eventuelt fire år. Arbeidssted er for tiden Campus Kristiansand. Tiltredelse etter avtale med fakultetet.

Fakultetet har fem institutter: Institutt for ernæring og folkehelse, Institutt for helse- og sykepleievitenskap, Institutt for idrettsvitenskap og kroppsøving, Institutt for psykologi og Institutt for psykososial helse. Postdoktorstillingen vil være tilknyttet forskningsgruppen PAHLS (Physical Activity and Health across the LifeSpan). I tillegg har instituttet forskningsgruppene SPADE (Sport Performance and Development Environments) og ROPE (Research in Outdoor Education and Physical Education).
Arbeidsoppgaver
I samarbeid med nasjonale og internasjonale forskningsinstitusjoner, kreftforeningen, rehabiliteringsinstitusjon og flere kommuner på Agder, og basert på erfaringer gjort i LETSGO-forskningsprosjekt (Lifestyle and Empowerment Techniques in Survivorship of Gynecologic Oncology - Universitetet i Agder), skal det utvikles en digital smarttelefonapplikasjon (app) med tilhørende opplæringsmodul. Denne skal utvikles sammen med brukere (individer berørt av kreft, helsearbeidere) og inneholde ulike fysisk aktivitets- og treningskomponenter. Videre skal denne implementeres i flere frisklivssentraler i kommuner på Agder. Vi skal evaluere implementeringen av denne. Deretter skal det lages en plan for hvordan app og opplæringsmodul kan rulles ut til alle landets kommuner. 

Den som ansettes vil sammen med prosjektleder ha ansvar for å utvikle studieprotokoll, kvalitetssikring av datainnsamling, harmonisering av data og koordinering av prosjektsamarbeidet mellom de involverte aktører involvert i prosjekter. Vedkommende skal også ha et spesielt ansvar for utviklingen av applikasjonen (sammen med andre forskere ved UiA samt UiAs IT-avdeling) samt implementeringsdelen i prosjektet. I tillegg skal det skrives forskningsartikler på allerede innsamlede og kommende data innenfor fagfeltet fysisk aktivitet/trening ved kreftsykdom. Det forventes at den aktuelle postdoktoren skal drive selvstendig forskning innen rammene for det nevnte prosjektet. Dersom det er aktuelt med undervisning/veiledning legges det også til rette for at kandidaten kan følge kurs i universitetspedagogikk (UniPed). Det er også ønskelig at kandidaten følger karriereutviklingsprogram alla postdoktorprogram. Den som tilsettes i stillingen vil få én faglig veileder.
Nødvendige kvalifikasjoner
Doktorgrad i idrettsvitenskap eller fagområde med relevans for utlysningen. Aktuelle søkere må ha fått godkjent avhandlingen innen søknadsfristen

Arbeidsspråket ved Universitetet i Agder er norsk. Den som ansettes må beherske norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk, skriftlig og muntlig. Det kreves gode kunnskaper i engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig. 

Ansettelsesvilkår for stilling som postdoktor fremgår av Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven.
Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
• Erfaring fra prosjektledelse eller koordinering av prosjekter
• Erfaring med bruk av bevegelsesmålere-/sensorer (aktivitetsmålere, pulsklokker m.m.) i prosjekter
• God teknologisk innsikt; blant annet bruk av smarttelefonapplikasjoner i forskning
• Erfaring med forskning innenfor fagfeltet trening/fysisk aktivitet ved kreftsykdom
• Kjennskap til implementeringsdesign og -metoder
• Erfaring med kvantitative forskningsmetoder, spesialt longitudinelle design
• Det er ønskelig at søkerne har disputert i løpet av de siste fem årPersonlige egenskaper
• Selvstendig
• Gode samarbeidsegenskaper
• Faglig engasjement
• Evne til å sette seg inn i nye problemstillinger og metodetilnærminger
Personlige egenskaper og egnethet for stillingen vil bli vektlagt.
Vi tilbyr
• Faglig utvikling i en stor, spennende og samfunnsviktig organisasjon
• Et godt, inkluderende og mangfoldig arbeidsmiljø
• Moderne lokaliteter og et allsidig velferdstilbud
• Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse
Mer om UiA som arbeidsplass.

Stillingen lønnes etter Statens lønnsregulativ lønnsplan 17.510, kode 1352 postdoktor, kr. 690 000 – 750 000 brutto pr år. For spesielt godt kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes. Fra lønnen går det lovfestet innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse. 
Generell informasjon
UiA er et åpent og inkluderende universitet. Vi har tro på at mangfold beriker arbeidsplassen og gjør oss bedre. Vi oppfordrer derfor kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, alder, kulturell bakgrunn, nedsatt funksjonsevne eller “hull i CV-en". 

Kvinner oppfordres spesielt til å søke stillingen. 

Den som ansettes, har rettigheter og plikter etter de retningslinjer som til enhver tid gjelder for stillingen. Ansettelse foretas av Ansettelsesutvalget for undervisnings- og forskerstillinger ved Universitetet i Agder. 

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli innkalt til intervju. Det vil også bli innhentet referanser etter nærmere avtale med søkeren. Det kan bli foretatt bakgrunnssjekk for å verifisere opplysninger som kommer frem av tilgjengelige dokumenter. Bakgrunnssjekk skjer alltid med søkerens samtykke, og ansettelse i stillingen forutsetter godkjent bakgrunnssjekk. Aktuelle søkere vil motta nærmere informasjon om dette. Mer om ansettelsesprosessen.  

I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, 2.ledd kan søker be om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlista. Universitetet kan likevel beslutte at navnet på søkeren skal offentliggjøres. Søker vil bli varslet i forkant ved eventuell offentliggjøring. 
Søknad
Søknaden og nødvendige opplysninger om utdanning og erfaring (inkludert vitnemål og attester) sendes elektronisk, benytt linken "Søk stillingen".

Følgende må lastes opp elektronisk:

• Vitnemål med karakterer
• Liste over publikasjoner
• Doktorgradsavhandlingen
• Eventuelt maksimalt 10 vitenskapelige arbeider og FoU-virksomhet som vedkommende vil ha tillagt særlig vekt ved bedømmelsen
Søkeren har selv ansvar for å levere fullstendig dokumentasjon digitalt innen søknadsfristen. All dokumentasjon må foreligge på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk.

Søknadsfrist: 2. desember 2026.
Kontaktinformasjon
For spørsmål eller nærmere opplysninger om stillingen og prosjektet knyttet til utlysningen:

• Professor Ingvild Vistad, SSHF/UiO, mobil 975 32 316, e-post ingvild.vistad@sshf.no 
• Instituttleder og prosjektleder Sveinung Berntsen, mobil 909 89 765, e-post sveinung.berntsen@uia.no
For spørsmål om søknadsprosessen:

• Rådgiver Daniel Øverdahl Perkis, mobil 980 54 299, e-post daniel.perkis@uia.noSammen om kunnskap
Når engasjerte mennesker samles om kunnskap, er alt mulig.

Universitetet i Agder kombinerer Sørlandets unike varme og nærhet med førsteklasses vitenskapelig, teknologisk og kunstnerisk kompetanse.

Universitetet i Agder har over 1500 ansatte og nesten 14 000 studenter. Det gjør oss til en av Sørlandets største arbeidsplasser. Våre ansatte forsker, underviser og formidler kunnskap fra alle sine fagområder.Universitetet holder til på to moderne campuser i Kristiansand og Grimstad.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Population Genetics and Plant Breeding
jobs.employer_name: NORGES MILJØ- OG BIOVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITET (NMBU) CAMPUS ÅS
jobs.description:
About the position
Be part of the future with NMBU!

The Department of Plant Sciences (IPV), Faculty of Biosciences, at the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU) has a vacancy for a permanent 100% position as Associate Professor in Population Genetics and Plant Breeding.

We are looking for an ambitious researcher and dedicated educator to strengthen NMBU's internationally recognized research and education in plant genetics, population genetics, and plant breeding with a focus on forage crops. This position represents a strategic investment in one of the department's core academic disciplines and will play a key role in educating the next generation of plant breeders and geneticists while advancing research that contributes to sustainable agriculture and future food security.

The successful candidate is expected to establish an internationally competitive research group within population genetics and plant breeding, with particular emphasis on quantitative genetics, breeding methodologies, genomics, genetic diversity, and the breeding of outcrossing crops. As part of our academic team, you will teach and supervise Bachelor, Master, and PhD students, contribute to attracting competitive national and international research funding, and strengthen collaborations with breeding companies, research institutes, and universities in Norway and abroad. 
 
You will play a leading role in further developing our educational portfolio within genetics and plant breeding and contribute to innovative teaching methods and student-active learning.

The successful candidate will become part of a highly interdisciplinary research environment with close collaboration across the Department of Plant Sciences, the Faculty of Biosciences, and other faculties at NMBU. The position also offers opportunities to contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives in population genetics, genomics, breeding methodologies, and climate-resilient agriculture, supporting both plant and animal science communities.

We are proud to educate highly skilled graduates and to conduct research with a strong societal impact. We are looking for candidates who combine scientific excellence with a passion for teaching, collaboration, and innovation. We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who will help shape the future of genetics and plant breeding at NMBU.
Main tasks
The successful candidate is expected to

• Conduct research of the highest international standard and strengthen research in population genetics, genomics, genomic selection, breeding methodologies, and climate-resilient crop development.
• Publish regularly in peer-reviewed international journals.
• Contribute to both basic and applied research.
• Secure external funding from national and international funding agencies, including Horizon Europe and the Research Council of Norway.
• Supervise PhD, MSc and BSc students.
• Contribute to innovation and collaboration with industry and breeding organization. 
• Network and collaborate within and outside NMBU and actively participate in interdisciplinary research initiatives across NMBU.
• Contribute to the strategic development of plant genetics and breeding activities at the department.
• Develop and deliver high-quality teaching in population genetics, plant breeding, quantitative genetics, genomics, and bioinformatics for plant breeding across Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD programmes.
• Contribute to educational excellence through student supervision, curriculum development, pedagogical innovation, and the implementation of research-based teaching and modern digital learning approaches.
• Conduct administrative tasks and other joint tasks at the faculty in collaboration with colleagues and students.Competence
All qualifications below are required for the position, unless it is specified that they are considered an advantage. 

Academic qualifications:

• A PhD in Plant Breeding, Population Genetics, Plant Science, or other fields related to the described position.
• Ability to develop and lead internationally recognized research within the subject area.
• Competence and experience with genetic research on forage crops.
• Experience in planning and conducting field experiments.
• Documented research output / publication record such as international peer-reviewed publications in relevant scientific journals, books, and research reports within population genetics and plant breeding.
• Experience with research relevant to Nordic agricultural conditions is considered an advantage
• Experience with research leadership is considered as an advantage
Educational qualifications (documented):

• Pedagogical education completed separate program at minimum 200 hours*.
• Teaching experience from higher education.
• Supervision experience.
• Basic teaching skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and development of own teaching and supervision.
• Experience with educational leadership is considered an advantage.*Those who do not meet the educational qualification at the time of employment shall be required to meet them within two years of employment.
Applied knowledge, among others

• Experience with dissemination is considered an advantage.
• Experience with industry collaboration is considered as an advantage.
Management, committees and boards and administration, among others

• Experience with management, committees and boards and administration is considered an advantage.
Special qualifications, among others

• Good written and oral communication skills in a Norwegian (or another Scandinavian language) and English is a prerequisite for performing the duties of the position.
Personal qualities, among others

• Outstanding collaborative and communicative skills both to the scientific community and to a broader community.
• Strong, professional commitment to excellence in teaching.
• Ability to realize scientific synergies between individual researchers and research groups.
• Strong potential for independent thinking displaying initiative and careful creative thought.
• Experience with building and maintaining a productive and energized research group.Remuneration and further information
The position is placed in position code 1011 Associate Professor (NOK 720 000 – 1 100 000) depending on qualifications. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. Seniority promotion in the position. 
 
Interested in learning more about the position? We are happy to tell you more about life on campus. Contact Section leader and researcher Sahameh Shafiee, tel:  +4767232769, (e-mail: sahameh.shafiee@nmbu.no). 

General information for applicants
Application
Send application electronically via the link "Apply for this job" at the top of this page. 

Application Deadline: : November 20th, 2026

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge's CV form and not just included as an attachment. This is in order to be able to comply with the regulations in the Public Administration Act §15.

The following must be included in the application:

• Short application text about your motivation
• Reflective statement (3–6 pages) addressing your reflections on the requirements of the position (see the job advertisement).
• Academic CV, diplomas and certificates
• Completed template for documentation of competence, link to template here.
• List of publications. Attach up to 15 scientific works that, according to assessment, are central to the production. If it is difficult to identify personal efforts in joint work, a brief account of your part of the work must be attached. 
NMBU has developed a matrix for assessing qualifications, which provides examples of results/competence, documentation, and reflection for all areas of the competence profile. We encourage you to familiarize yourself with the matrix and use it when applying for the position. See this page for more information on how to document your qualifications and write a reflection note.

Documents that cannot be sent electronically are sent in triplicate by ordinary mail marked still.nr. 26/09329 to NMBU, Faculty of Biosciences, P.O. Box 5003, NO-1432 Ås, within 20.11.2026.

Please note that the report from the expert committee will be sent to all applicants.
About The Faculty of Biosciences
The Faculty of Biosciences (BIOVIT) aims to shape the future of food and bioproduction through teaching and research in biology and sustainable production and use of plants, livestock and fish. The faculty has a large project portfolio and an annual turnover of approximately NOK 250 million. 

BIOVIT is organized into seven research groups: Genome Biology, Breeding, Genetics and Food Production Systems, Ruminant Nutrition and Physiology, Ethology and Animal Welfare, Nutrition and Physiology for Monogastric Animals, Plant Biology, Sustainable Food Systems and Integrated Plant Protection, and Genetics, Evolution and Sustainable Plant Production. Additionally, the faculty has seven research support and laboratory units.

BIOVIT is responsible for bachelor’s and master’s programs in aquaculture, biology, animal science, and plant science, as well as English-language master’s programs in Agroecology, Plant Sciences, Feed Manufacturing Technology, and Genome Sciences. BIOVIT also offers Ph.D. programs in animal science and plant science. Currently, the faculty has about 550 bachelor’s and master’s students and 90 Ph.D. students. BIOVIT employs approximately 230 staff members and has its own faculty administration.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NMBU will contribute to securing the future of life through outstanding research, education, communication and innovation. We have the country's most satisfied university students, who receive research-based education in a unique student environment. Our graduates gain a high level of competence in interdisciplinary collaboration and are popular in the labor market.

NMBU has internationally leading research environments in several subjects. Together with our partners in society and business, we contribute to solving some of the biggest societal challenges of our time. We focus on innovation, communication and entrepreneurship because we believe these challenges are best solved with joint efforts. We believe that a good working environment is characterized by diversity.If necessary, workplace adaptations will be made for persons with disabilities. More information about NMBU is available at www.nmbu.no/en

About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centres. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As IT Lead, you will establish and run Nordscale Operations’ internal IT function in Narvik. As our first internal IT appointment, you will initially focus on hands-on operations and employee support, working closely with our external IT provider. You will also collaborate across functions within the organisation, beyond day-to-day user support.

 

The scope covers internal corporate IT and access to partner systems. As the organisation grows, your responsibility will expand towards IT strategy.

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)

• Run day-to-day IT operations: configure PCs and software, support users, and manage onboarding, accounts, access, and single sign-on across internal and partner systems.
• Establish IT policies and procedures for cybersecurity, data protection, and business continuity; implement Nscale’s configuration and security requirements with site leadership and external specialists.
• Manage equipment and software procurement, licences, asset lifecycles, and relationships with IT vendors and service providers.
• Deliver upgrades, migrations, and technical refreshes; monitor performance, uptime, and user experience; and develop compatible, scalable infrastructure and support services.
 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may be an experienced IT consultant, systems administrator, or operational IT professional ready to build a function. Experience in or supporting larger organisations with several partners is valuable; previous senior IT leadership experience is not required.

 

You enjoy practical work, connect technical decisions with longer-term business needs, and keep up to date with technology trends.

 

Key Characteristics

• Self-driven and structured, taking ownership of decisions, priorities, and outcomes.
• A service-oriented problem-solver who identifies risks and preventive measures.
• Collaborative across teams and partners, with the ability to explain technical matters clearly to non-technical colleagues.
 

Skills & Qualifications

• Solid hands-on experience across networks, infrastructure, cloud services, software administration, user support, and account and access management.
• Good working knowledge of cybersecurity, data protection, and compliance, including implementing policies and procedures.
• Experience with IT assets, procurement, licences, and vendors, plus upgrades, migrations, and scalable service improvements.
• Fluent Norwegian and English, written and spoken. Relevant IT management, systems administration, or cybersecurity certification is desirable, not required.
 

What We Can Offer You

• Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
• The opportunity to build an internal IT function, combining practical technical work with a path towards broader strategic responsibility.
• Relocation support assessed individually, if required.
 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.description:

• 
Make sure the work follows the drawings, the plan and the quality requirements

Do site inspections and find quality, safety or schedule problems early

Take part in coordination meetings with the client and other contractors

jobs.occupation: Logistics Supervisor – Data Centre Projects
jobs.description:
The right material, in the right place, at the right time.
Fortica builds and finishes data centres across Norway and the Nordics. As Logistics Supervisor you make sure materials, equipment and plant reach the site at the right time, in the right place and in good condition, safely and without holding up the work. This includes heavy and sensitive data centre equipment such as generators, transformers, switchgear, UPS units, chillers and server racks.
What you will do
• 
Run the delivery schedule and the booking system for delivery slots, in line with the 2–6 week look-ahead plan

• 
Plan oversized deliveries (routes, permits and escorts) and track long-lead equipment (items that take months to deliver)

• 
Manage laydown areas (storage zones on site), unloading zones, site roads and the site store

• 
Receive deliveries: check quantity, condition and paperwork, and report any damage

• 
Coordinate cranes, forklifts and telehandlers, and take part in lift planning and risk assessments

• 
Coordinate daily with subcontractors, suppliers and hauliers

• 
Make sure safety (HSE) rules are followed and logistics areas are kept clean and tidy

• 
Send a weekly logistics report and check logistics costs before invoices are approved

• 
Lead a small team of delivery coordinators, storekeepers, plant operators and banksmen (signallers who guide lifts and vehicles)
Who you are
• 
Hands-on experience with heavy lifting and site logistics on large construction projects

• 
Experience leading a logistics or warehouse team

• 
Structured, and good at planning ahead

• 
Comfortable with Excel or similar planning tools

• 
Good English, spoken and written

• 
Driving licence class B

• 
Lifting or forklift certificates (for example truckførerbevis) are a plus
What makes you a good fit
You plan ahead and keep control when there is a lot of time pressure. You stand firm on safety and stop unsafe lifts or deliveries. You communicate clearly and solve conflicts between subcontractors before they grow.

• 
3:1 rotation (3 weeks on, 1 week off) with flights, accommodation and meals covered

• 
4 % pension and health insurance

• 
We help you get your HMS card (the Norwegian ID card for everyone working on a construction site) if you do not have one

• 
Real responsibility on large, modern projects

• 
A safe workplace with fair terms and a written employment contract

Part of CTS Group, one of Europe's leading data centre design and build groups

jobs.occupation: UAS Pilot
jobs.description:
We are looking for a qualified military veteran with verified combat and instructional experience in Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and/or Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) to join us in Oslo as a UAS Pilot.

If you hold internationally recognised UAV operator certifications, have completed professional instructor training with a certified training provider, and are capable of delivering personnel training in accordance with NATO and EU requirements and modern military standards, don't hesitate to reach out to me.

In this role, you will:

• 
Conduct classroom instruction, simulator sessions, and supervised flight training covering UAS operation, mission planning, system capabilities, and emergency procedures, with UGV instruction where qualified.

• 
Prepare lesson plans, training materials, and practical exercises aligned with the centre’s approved syllabus, applicable EU and national aviation requirements, and relevant NATO and military training standards.

• 
Prepare training missions, perform risk assessments and pre-flight checks, confirm airspace and operating permissions, and supervise activities in accordance with established safety procedures.

• 
Evaluate theoretical knowledge and practical performance, provide structured feedback and remedial instruction, and maintain accurate attendance, assessment, and qualification records.

• 
Conduct serviceability checks, identify and report defects, coordinate maintenance with technical personnel, and ensure training aircraft, ground-control systems, simulators, and associated equipment are ready for use.

• 
Work with instructors, technical staff, and international partners to deliver consistent training; contribute to exercises and post-training reviews; and support emergency preparedness and first-aid response within the scope of certification.

You have:

• 
Military service experience in UAV units, reconnaissance, artillery, Special Operations Forces (SOF), robotic systems, or related fields.

• 
At least 5 years of hands-on experience operating UAVs and/or UGVs.

• 
Proven experience as an instructor, trainer, or operator training lead.

• 
Valid UAV operator certificates recognised in the European Union (EASA Open Category A1/A3 and A2, Specific Category, or equivalent national certifications).

• 
English proficiency at C1 level or above.

• 
Knowledge of risk management procedures, flight safety, mission planning, and operations in an international environment.

• 
First aid certification at FPOS Level 3, FREC 3, or an equivalent international standard (TCCC, TECC, Combat Lifesaver).

• 
Completion of an instructor training course delivered by a Recognised Training Provider / Awarding Organisation or another officially recognised training provider.

• 
Ability to deliver theoretical and practical training sessions, assess trainees, and prepare training documentation.

What We Offer

• 
An opportunity to join a growing technology company at an exciting stage of development

• 
Meaningful responsibility and direct impact on products and processes

• 
A collaborative and international working environment

• 
Professional development and career growth opportunities

• 
Competitive compensation and benefits package
